body: Session of 2026-09-05. Designed the continuity hand-off change and shipped three of its seven goals.U+000AU+000ATHE ROUTE. Two documents on main carry everything needed. docs/specs/2026-09-05-continuity-handoff.md holds invariants I1-I9, rulings H1-H8 with their reasoning, and the seven units. docs/plans/2026-09-05-continuity-handoff/PLAN.md holds Tasks 1-7, each with real test code and exact change sites. Read both before touching anything. This pointer is prose rather than a stored link because Logbook has no artifacts writer yet - closing that is goal 5.U+000AU+000AWHAT IS ON MAIN. Goals 1-3 are marked done above, each carrying its receipt.U+000AU+002D U1, PR 191: declared session focus deleted from the pointer, briefing, resume_thread, update_thread and the preflight skill. Three fields left the published wire contract. 780 pass.U+000AU+002D U2, PR 194: spine.landed, Artifact.retired and Risk.retired added, all required and non-optional. 785 pass.U+000AU+002D U7, PR 193 plus 195: the stop gate blocks unless ledger movement touched the held thread; an unreadable git clears it. 805 pass.U+000AU+000AWHAT REMAINS. Goal 4 is the artifact merge (U3), goal 5 the writers (U4), goal 6 the briefing render (U5), goal 7 the two skills (U6).U+000AU+000AORDER, and why each constraint is real rather than habit.U+000AU3 and U5 are file-disjoint and go in parallel now: U3 owns src/merge/field-merge.ts, U5 owns src/render/briefing.ts, and their tests do not overlap.U+000AU4 must follow U3. Ship the artifact writers first and every artifact written is silently dropped on the next sync, because the merge does not read the field until U3 wires it.U+000AU6 must follow U4. The debrief skill will reference park_thread.landed, and test/contract/skills.test.ts cross-checks skill references against real tool output schema keys, so it goes red against a field that does not exist yet.U+000AU+000AWHAT COST TIME IN THIS SESSION, so it does not cost it again.U+000AThere are three closed censuses, not two. test/contract/no-path.test.ts runs scan-to-tagged, so removing a tool argument degrades it silently rather than halting it.U+000Atest/contract/content-rendered.test.ts forces every content()-classed schema field onto a rendered surface. Wrapping a field in content() therefore compels a render whether the unit intended one or not - that is why U2 shipped a Landed line in the thread resource. Nothing asserts it yet; U5 owns closing that.U+000AThe merge strategy table and the merge itself are two separate edits. A field present in THREAD_RULES but absent from mergeThreadTraced passes the existing census while being dropped by every merge. Adding a rule entry alone also breaks the merge: without a matching SCALAR_DESCRIPTORS entry the value is laundered by a cast, JSON.stringify drops the key, and every merged record is refused.U+000AA GitHub Actions re-run replays the original event payload. Editing a PR body and re-running the receipts gate does nothing, because the workflow listens on [opened, synchronize, reopened] and edited is not among them. Close and reopen instead.U+000Apr-create bullets every field value, and the receipts G11 acknowledgement matcher is a line-anchored test-removal pattern that a leading hyphen defeats. A PR deleting a test currently needs a hand-edited body, then a reopen.U+000ADelivery leads that fan out reviewers and wait exhaust their turn with the work unpushed. This happened three times. Brief them to commit and push first, then review.U+000AU+000AWHAT I GOT WRONG, corrected in the documents.U+000AI9 as first written was unsatisfiable; it now names the carve-out where an unreadable git clears the gate.U+000AI told a lead that -- was the wrong git sentinel. It is not: both -- and --end-of-options are load-bearing and do different jobs, and removing either opens a distinct fail-open. The shipped invocation carries both.U+000AI claimed U1, U2 and U7 were file-disjoint. Making U2's fields required forced it into fixtures the other two owned, and they collided on merge.U+000AU+000ASTATE AT HAND-OFF. All five pull requests are merged. Working branch is main. No branch is outstanding and no worktree holds unpushed work.
